title: Sheaf realization of a supplied localized perfect cut
statement: Let X,K,s,U,A,M and the affine model comparison be as in [lem-sc-affine-principal-model-comparison]. Suppose f is outside the prime of s. Write N=A_f tensor_A M [def-pc-ring-tensor-cohomology]. Assume a supplied splitting Q(N) isomorphic to Q(tau_le_0 N) direct-sum Q(tau_ge_1 N), and a supplied bounded complex T of finite projective A_f-modules, zero below degree one, representing Q(tau_ge_1 N). Then on some open neighbourhood V of s, K restricted to V splits as its canonical nonpositive truncation direct-sum P, where P is perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex] and has derived tensor cohomology [def-pc-derived-tensor-cohomology-vanishes] zero below degree one. No Tor-amplitude or fibre-map hypothesis on K is used: the localization splitting and positive model are explicit hypotheses.

source.place: Tag 0A1U, Lemma better-cut-complex-in-two, affine reduction and conclusion

proof.text: Use the principal-open comparison to obtain V and exact additive associated-sheaf functor F preserving finite free modules. Apply its derived functor to the supplied splitting; it preserves biproducts and identifies the whole object with K restricted to V.

source.place: Tag 0A1U, Lemma better-cut-complex-in-two, affine reduction and conclusion

proof.text: A finite projective module is a retract of a finite free module. Apply F to the splitting maps in each degree of T. Restricting to the whole-open over-site gives strictly perfect local models with the bounds of T. Thus Q(F(T)) is perfect. These retracts are flat; the upper bound gives K-flatness. Tensoring with a sheaf in degree zero preserves the zero terms below one, so its homology vanishes there.

source.place: Tag 0A1U, Lemma better-cut-complex-in-two, affine reduction and conclusion

proof.text: Exactness puts the image of tau_le_0 N in D_le_0, and the model T puts the other summand in D_ge_1. Apply tau_lt_1 to the splitting: it is identity on the first summand and zero on the second. This identifies the first summand with tau_lt_1 of K restricted to V. Substitute that isomorphism into the splitting.

theorem affine_perfect_cut_sheaf_realization (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (U : X.Opens) (V : U.toScheme.Opens),
      HasDerivedCategory.{w}
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (s : X)
    (U : X.Opens) (hsU : s ∈ U) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    [∀ f : X.presheaf.obj (.op U),
      HasDerivedCategory.{u} (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.Away f))]
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.obj (.op U))) ℤ)
    (eM : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj K ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((Scheme.affinePerfectSheafification X U hU).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj M)))
    (f : X.presheaf.obj (.op U)) (hf : f ∉ (hU.isoSpec.hom ⟨s, hsU⟩).asIdeal)
    (esplit : Nonempty
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((RingTensorCohomology.extend _ (Localization.Away f)).obj M) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((RingTensorCohomology.extend _ (Localization.Away f)).obj M).truncLE 0) ⊞
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((RingTensorCohomology.extend _ (Localization.Away f)).obj M).truncGE 1)))
    (hpos : ∃ (T : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.Away f)) ℤ) (b : ℤ),
      T.IsStrictlyGE 1 ∧ T.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Projective (Localization.Away f) (T.X i) ∧
        Module.Finite (Localization.Away f) (T.X i)) ∧
      Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((RingTensorCohomology.extend _ (Localization.Away f)).obj M).truncGE 1) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj T)) :
    ∃ V : X.Opens, s ∈ V ∧ ∃ P : schemeDerivedCategory V.toScheme,
      Scheme.IsPerfect V.toScheme P ∧
      (∀ F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace),
        ∀ i : ℤ, i < 1 → schemeDerivedTensorCohomologyVanishes V.toScheme P F i) ∧
      Nonempty
        (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) V) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj K ≅
          (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncLT 1).obj
            (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) V) ⋙
              Equivalence.functor
                (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))
                (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
                (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ⊞ P)
